messages.content: Write only a specific comparison for a Council decision brief, at most 40 words. The source facts will appear separately in the brief. Explain exactly how the delegate's statement and the adopted provision relate. State who gives advice or information and who decides if the relationship concerns procedure. For a timing relationship, state the delegate's preference and the actual timing and force of the adopted text. Keep the speaker's own stance separate from what the Council adopted. Do not infer endorsement, agreement or legal authority from a shared topic. Return exactly NONE when there is no specific supported link. Use only the two fields below. Return only the comparison. In a supported comparison embed one short exact phrase from each source in double quotes. Choose phrases that carry the actor, action, timing or legal force. Copy the operative verb exactly when its force matters. Attribute each quote to its own source and state their specific relationship. Count the quoted words toward the same 40-word limit.

It established a consensus-based working group whose functions include reviewing the Focal Point’s twice-yearly reports."}
